welcome:
👋 Welcome to **Nabi Hub | Uploader** bot!

Send a file link to receive it.
welcome_admin:
👑 Hello Admin!

Welcome to the **Nabi Hub | Uploader** admin panel.
Select a section from the menu below:
force_join_msg: ⚠️ Please join the following channels before using the bot:
force_join_passed: ✅ Membership verified! You can now use the bot.
force_join_failed: ❌ You haven't joined all channels yet. Please join and try again.
reaction_lock_msg: ❤️ Please react to the specified post in the channel.
reaction_lock_failed: ❌ You haven't reacted yet. Please react first.
upload_start:
📤 Please send the file you want to upload.

Use the 'Cancel' button to abort.
upload_album_start:
📦 Please send the album files one by one.

When done, press 'Finish Upload'.
upload_link_prompt: 🔗 Please send the direct file link:
error_occurred: ⚠️ An error occurred. Please try again.
no_permission: ⛔ You don't have permission for this operation.
forward_prompt:
⏩ Please forward the message you want to broadcast:

(Forward from a channel or group)
enter_user_id: 👤 Please enter the user numeric ID:
enter_caption:
📝 Please send the desired caption:

You can use HTML formatting.
enter_delay: ⏱ Please enter the delay in seconds:
album_files_received:
📦 Files received: {count}

Continue or press 'Finish Upload'.
